name: SalesAgents
technicalDescription: Who approves a disputed price: each sales agent (Customers/Invoices.salesAgentName) with email and the manager who approves after the agent. Read by AnalyzePriceGap / CreatePriceApprovalRequest. Agents and managers never log in; the bookkeeper marks their approvals with evidence.

columns.name: agentName
columns.description: Sales agent display name, as on Customers.salesAgentName

columns.name: managerName
columns.description: Manager who approves after the agent (display name)

columns.name: isTestFixture
columns.description: True for marked test data; DeleteTestFixtures removes these rows. Writers always set it (no defaults).

columns.name: authorizedCustomerCodes
columns.description: Customer codes this agent may request statements / open debts for, comma-separated. A mail from this agent's address about one of them is מאומת

columns.name: authorizedCustomerNames
columns.description: Display names of those customers, comma-separated, same order (denormalised)
